PARTITION(A, p, r)
1  x = A[r]
2  i = p - 1
3  for j = p to r - 1
4      if A[j] ≤ x
5          i = i + 1
6          exchange(A[i], A[j])
7  exchange(A[i+1], A[r])
8  return i + 1

1  x = A[p]
2  i = p
3  for j = p + 1 to r

5          i = i + 1
6          exchange(A[i], A[j])
7  ________
8  ________

第 1 格：exchange(A[p],A[i])
